scope.game: Los Angeles Chargers at Baltimore Ravens

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of final scheduled game of Week 9

methodology.qualification: Market HR >=6/10 OR at least one applicable fixed ladder >=8/10
methodology.p15: 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games; linear interpolation; unavailable when fewer than 20
methodology.market_hit_definition: Actual game statistic strictly greater than current main-market line

data_integrity_notes: Current FanDuel main-market rows unavailable for Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris, KeAndre Lambert-Smith, and Charlie Kolar; ladder-only qualification assessed where applicable.
Ladd McConkey excluded because the Chargers' official Week 10 injury report lists him Out.
Jacoby Brissett is Baltimore's named Week 10 starter; Justin Herbert is the Chargers' named starter.
The historical source contains duplicate short-name J.Lane records; the Baltimore game-history record was matched to Week 10 Ravens player Ja'Kobi Lane.
